mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('EQU_', LPAD(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(MAX(A1.ITEM_ID), 5, 16), 0) + 1, 16, '0')) AS ITEM_ID FROM ARTEQUM A1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ARTEQUM ( ITEM_ID, USER_NM, ZIP, ADRES_LOT, ADRES, DETAIL_ADRES, USR_TELNO, CHG_USER_ID, CRT_DATE, CHG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, ENCRYPT(#{userNm}), ENCRYPT(#{zip}), ENCRYPT(#{adresLot}), ENCRYPT(#{adres}), ENCRYPT(#{detailAdres}), ENCRYPT(REPLACE(#{usrTelno}, '-', '')), #{chgUserId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ARTEQUM SET USER_NM = ENCRYPT(#{userNm}), ZIP = ENCRYPT(#{zip}), ADRES_LOT = ENCRYPT(#{adresLot}), ADRES = ENCRYPT(#{adres}), DETAIL_ADRES = ENCRYPT(#{detailAdres}), USR_TELNO = ENCRYPT(REPLACE(#{usrTelno}, '-', '')), CHG_USER_ID = #{chgUserId}, CHG_DATE = NOW() WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT A1.SEQ FROM ARTEQUD A1 WHERE A1.ITEM_ID = #{_parameter} ORDER BY A1.SEQ ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ARTEQUD A1 WHERE A1.ITEM_ID = #{_parameter} AND A1.PAY_STA = '01'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ARTEQUD ( ITEM_ID, SEQ, PAY_STA, REQ_DATE, START_DATE, PLAN_DATE, COMP_DATE, AGENCY, EQUIP_COST, EQUIP_PAY, CHG_USER_ID, CRT_DATE, CHG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{seq}, #{paySta}, #{reqDate}, #{startDate}, #{planDate}, #{compDate}, #{agency}, #{equipCost}, #{equipPay}, #{chgUserId}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE PAY_STA = VALUES(PAY_STA), REQ_DATE = VALUES(REQ_DATE), START_DATE = VALUES(START_DATE), PLAN_DATE = VALUES(PLAN_DATE), COMP_DATE = VALUES(COMP_DATE), AGENCY = VALUES(AGENCY), EQUIP_COST = VALUES(EQUIP_COST), EQUIP_PAY = VALUES(EQUIP_PAY), CHG_USER_ID = VALUES(CHG_USER_ID), CHG_DATE = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT A1.ITEM_ID AS itemId, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.USER_NM), '') AS userNm, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.ZIP), '') AS zip, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.ADRES_LOT), '') AS adresLot, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.ADRES), '') AS adres, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.DETAIL_ADRES), '') AS detailAdres, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.USR_TELNO), '') AS usrTelno FROM ARTEQUM A1 WHERE A1.ITEM_ID = #{_parameter}

SELECT A1.ITEM_ID AS itemId, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.USER_NM), '') AS userNm, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.ZIP), '') AS zip, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.ADRES_LOT), '') AS adresLot, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.ADRES), '') AS adres, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.DETAIL_ADRES), '') AS detailAdres, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A1.USR_TELNO), '') AS usrTelno FROM ARTEQUM A1 WHERE A1.ITEM_ID = #{_parameter}

SELECT A1.SEQ AS seq, COALESCE(A1.PAY_STA, '') AS paySta, DATE_FORMAT(A1.REQ_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reqDate, DATE_FORMAT(A1.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(A1.PLAN_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS planDate, DATE_FORMAT(A1.COMP_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS compDate, COALESCE(A1.AGENCY, '') AS agency, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_COST, 0) AS equipCost, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_PAY, 0) AS equipPay FROM ARTEQUD A1 WHERE A1.ITEM_ID = #{_parameter} ORDER BY A1.SEQ DESC

SELECT A1.SEQ AS seq, COALESCE(A1.PAY_STA, '') AS paySta, DATE_FORMAT(A1.REQ_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reqDate, DATE_FORMAT(A1.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(A1.PLAN_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS planDate, DATE_FORMAT(A1.COMP_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS compDate, COALESCE(A1.AGENCY, '') AS agency, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_COST, 0) AS equipCost, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_PAY, 0) AS equipPay, A2.SEQ2 AS seq2, DATE_FORMAT(A2.PAY_DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') AS payDay, COALESCE(A2.PAY, 0) AS pay, COALESCE(A2.PAY_DESC, '') AS payDesc FROM ARTEQUD A1 LEFT JOIN ARTEQUP A2 ON A2.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND A2.SEQ = A1.SEQ WHERE A1.ITEM_ID = #{_parameter} ORDER BY A1.SEQ DESC, A2.SEQ2 ASC

sql.if: AND ( DECRYPT(A2.ZIP) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{address}, '%') OR DECRYPT(A2.ADRES_LOT) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{address}, '%') OR DECRYPT(A2.ADRES) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{address}, '%') OR DECRYPT(A2.DETAIL_ADRES) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{address}, '%') )

if.test: paySta != null and paySta != '' and paySta != '00'

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ARTEQUD A1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MAX(SEQ) AS MAX_SEQ FROM ARTEQUD GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) AL ON AL.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND AL.MAX_SEQ = A1.SEQ JOIN ARTEQUM A2 ON A2.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1

SELECT A1.ITEM_ID AS itemId, A1.SEQ AS seq, COALESCE(A1.PAY_STA, '') AS paySta, DATE_FORMAT(A1.REQ_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reqDate, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.USER_NM), '') AS userNm, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.ZIP), '') AS zip, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.ADRES_LOT), '') AS adresLot, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.ADRES), '') AS adres, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.DETAIL_ADRES), '') AS detailAdres, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_COST, 0) AS equipCost, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_PAY, 0) AS equipPay, ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(P1.PAY_DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') FROM ARTEQUP P1 WHERE P1.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND P1.SEQ = A1.SEQ ORDER BY P1.PAY_DAY DESC, P1.SEQ2 DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS payDay, COALESCE(( SELECT P2.PAY FROM ARTEQUP P2 WHERE P2.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND P2.SEQ = A1.SEQ ORDER BY P2.PAY_DAY DESC, P2.SEQ2 DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS pay FROM ARTEQUD A1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MAX(SEQ) AS MAX_SEQ FROM ARTEQUD GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) AL ON AL.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND AL.MAX_SEQ = A1.SEQ JOIN ARTEQUM A2 ON A2.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY A1.REQ_DATE DESC, A1.ITEM_ID DESC, A1.SEQ DESC LIMIT ${startIndex}, ${lengthPage}

SELECT A1.ITEM_ID AS itemId, A1.SEQ AS seq, COALESCE(A1.PAY_STA, '') AS paySta, DATE_FORMAT(A1.REQ_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reqDate, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.USER_NM), '') AS userNm, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.ZIP), '') AS zip, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.ADRES_LOT), '') AS adresLot, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.ADRES), '') AS adres, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.DETAIL_ADRES), '') AS detailAdres, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_COST, 0) AS equipCost, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_PAY, 0) AS equipPay, ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(P1.PAY_DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') FROM ARTEQUP P1 WHERE P1.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND P1.SEQ = A1.SEQ ORDER BY P1.PAY_DAY DESC, P1.SEQ2 DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS payDay, COALESCE(( SELECT P2.PAY FROM ARTEQUP P2 WHERE P2.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND P2.SEQ = A1.SEQ ORDER BY P2.PAY_DAY DESC, P2.SEQ2 DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS pay FROM ARTEQUD A1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MAX(SEQ) AS MAX_SEQ FROM ARTEQUD GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) AL ON AL.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND AL.MAX_SEQ = A1.SEQ JOIN ARTEQUM A2 ON A2.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY A1.REQ_DATE DESC, A1.ITEM_ID DESC, A1.SEQ DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ARTEQUD A1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MAX(SEQ) AS MAX_SEQ FROM ARTEQUD GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) AL ON AL.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND AL.MAX_SEQ = A1.SEQ JOIN ARTEQUM A2 ON A2.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID WHERE A1.PAY_STA = '01' AND A1.REQ_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A1.REQ_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{baseMonth}, 1, 4), '-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND A1.REQ_DATE < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{baseMonth}, 1, 4), '-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)

SELECT A1.ITEM_ID AS itemId, A1.SEQ AS seq, COALESCE(A1.PAY_STA, '') AS paySta, DATE_FORMAT(A1.REQ_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reqDate, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.USER_NM), '') AS userNm, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.ZIP), '') AS zip, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.ADRES_LOT), '') AS adresLot, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.ADRES), '') AS adres, COALESCE(DECRYPT(A2.DETAIL_ADRES), '') AS detailAdres, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_COST, 0) AS equipCost, COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_PAY, 0) AS equipPay, ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(P1.PAY_DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') FROM ARTEQUP P1 WHERE P1.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND P1.SEQ = A1.SEQ ORDER BY P1.PAY_DAY DESC, P1.SEQ2 DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS payDay, COALESCE(( SELECT P2.PAY FROM ARTEQUP P2 WHERE P2.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND P2.SEQ = A1.SEQ ORDER BY P2.PAY_DAY DESC, P2.SEQ2 DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS pay FROM ARTEQUD A1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MAX(SEQ) AS MAX_SEQ FROM ARTEQUD GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) AL ON AL.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND AL.MAX_SEQ = A1.SEQ JOIN ARTEQUM A2 ON A2.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID WHERE A1.PAY_STA = '01' AND A1.REQ_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A1.REQ_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{baseMonth}, 1, 4), '-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND A1.REQ_DATE < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{baseMonth}, 1, 4), '-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ORDER BY A1.REQ_DATE DESC, A1.ITEM_ID DESC, A1.SEQ DESC LIMIT ${startIndex}, ${lengthPage}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ARTEQUP ( ITEM_ID, SEQ, SEQ2, PAY_DAY, PAY, PAY_DESC, CHG_USER_ID, CRT_DATE, CHG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{seq}, #{seq2}, #{payDay}, #{pay}, #{payDesc}, #{chgUserId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ARTEQUD A1 SET A1.EQUIP_PAY = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(P1.PAY, 0)), 0) FROM ARTEQUP P1 WHERE P1.ITEM_ID = A1.ITEM_ID AND P1.SEQ = A1.SEQ ), A1.CHG_DATE = NOW() WHERE A1.ITEM_ID = #{_parameter}

UPDATE ARTEQUD A1 SET A1.PAY_STA = CASE WHEN A1.EQUIP_COST IS NULL THEN A1.PAY_STA WHEN COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_PAY, 0) >= COALESCE(A1.EQUIP_COST, 0) THEN '02' ELSE '01' END, A1.CHG_USER_ID = #{chgUserId}, A1.CHG_DATE = NOW() WHERE A1.ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
